forbidden_scope: UI/3D viewer implementation (future visualization coordinates are artifacts only)

pipeline_contract.embedding_input: feature_views (semantic_view + role_view + structural_vector) derived only from canonical records
pipeline_contract.disposability_test: rm -rf artifacts/prompt-topology/* && python scripts/prompt-topology/run.py => byte-identical rederivation given same registry+config+embedding responses

ordering_contract.cluster_order_within_family: sort by (-member_count, cluster_id_lexicographic) where cluster_id=C- + first 6 hex of SHA256(sorted member ids joined by ',') uppercase; OUTLIER last
ordering_contract.role_rank: index in config.ordering.sprint_role_order; unlisted types sort after listed lexicographically
ordering_contract.centrality: mean composite similarity to all members of same cluster (higher first, rounded 4 decimals)
ordering_contract.final_tie_break: prompt_id lexicographic; guarantees strict total order and stability
ordering_contract.linear_order: flatten(groups in family_order -> clusters in cluster_order -> prompts in intra_cluster order); outliers_group appended last
ordering_contract.source_vs_derived: canonical library order remains sequence_ascending per prompt-kit-order-navigation contract; topology linear_order is complementary recommendation metadata
determinism_guarantees: explicit random_seed=42 for every stochastic stage

artifacts.future_visualization_ready: artifacts/prompt-topology/projection-3d.json (x,y,z per prompt) + cluster shape metadata in kit-order.json — consumed by future viewer, not classifier correctness

gates.new_prompt_possible_duplicate_blocks_afk: composite>=0.94 && role>=0.88 && same sprint_path_role => fail creation gate until explicit STRENGTHEN|CREATE_NEW disposition
gates.promotion_gate: harness-completeness must remain PASS; new prompt-topology domain contract registers only when implementation proves definition-of-done bullets

afkaf_gate.flow: proposed prompt -> canonicalize -> embed -> compare vs current topology -> top neighbors + candidate family/cluster -> decision packet {STRENGTHEN|POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE|CREATE_NEW} -> only then may prompt_registry_ops allocate new ID

proof_ceiling: Design contract and deterministic schema/config/ordering policy proof only. No embedding execution, no clustering run, no 3D browser rendering, no live AFKAF allocation, no production population of artifacts/prompt-topology/* is proven until the implementation sprint executes the orchestrated pipeline and the validator reproduces byte-identical disposable artifacts on the tested commit.
